_comment: The application metadata the three package builds show to users (macOS Finder and Quick Look, Windows file Properties, Linux software centres and desktop menus) that no other source already declares. tools/lib/app-metadata.cjs reads it with the values it derives instead of repeating them: the copyright holder, the first year and the licence from LICENSE, the website from CNAME, the repository and issue tracker from _shared/updater/data/defaults.json and the product name from identifiers.json. publisher is the Windows CompanyName and the RPM Vendor; summary is the one-line description every package shows; description holds the paragraphs of the long descriptions (AppStream, Debian); macos_category is the launcher's LSApplicationCategoryType and freedesktop_categories the desktop entries' Categories, keywords their search terms and the AppStream keywords; metadata_license is the licence of the AppStream file itself.
summary: Hotstrings and shortcuts to type faster and more ergonomically
description: Ergopti+ is an open-source keyboard companion: a hotstring engine, keyboard shortcuts, typing statistics and AI-assisted text expansion around the Ergopti keyboard layout.
On Linux it runs as a user daemon that reads evdev and injects through uinput, so it needs the input and uinput group membership the project installer sets up.
